camera motion: track_camera gives translation and turning in the start view. Zoom: track_camera_zoom. Returning view: check_scene_revisit.
entity motion: track_entity uses world unless the question names starting facing (subject) or the moving view (camera). Facing: track_orientation.
entity and camera: track_entity(main=X, frame_of_reference=camera) measures distance and how the camera sees X; subject measures which side of X the camera occupies. Image size and visibility: get_segmentation_mask.
entities and landmarks: track_entity(main=X, others=[Y], frame_of_reference=subject) measures distance and side of Y relative to X.
counting: Find instances with get_segmentation_mask or detect_all_entities; track_multiple_entities if motion matters. You decide the count using segmented frames.
visual: ask_video can receive the question and options. Use get_frames to look yourself.
